mentions.name: wgsl-rs
mentions.description: A Rust proc-macro crate that lets developers write WGSL shaders in a subset of Rust; the same code runs on the CPU for testing and on the GPU via generated WGSL, working on stable Rust with no custom toolchains needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building wgsl-rs, a proc macro crate that lets you write WGSL shaders in a subset of Rust — same code runs on the CPU for testing and on the GPU via generated WGSL. Works on stable Rust, no custom toolchains needed.
